versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the "cad-editor" skill.
- Generate engineering drawings from natural language prompts, covering architecture, mechanical, electrical, piping, and structural domains.
- Support for DXF file creation, preview rendering (PNG/SVG/PDF), and batch export.
- Follows GB/T drafting standards; includes API for precision control and industry-specific drawing templates and components.
- Automatic intent recognition and parameter extraction from user commands; outputs both preview image and download link for CAD file.
- Requires installation of ezdxf, matplotlib, and numpy.
